resources.string: A private mood journal that stays on this phone. First, pick a language: the starter moods, tags and examples are written in it.
More languages are on the way.
Bring your entries, photos, moods and tags along. Dakilio then starts from your backup instead of the examples.
Open Daylio\'s backup screen, export a backup and pick Dakilio in the share menu. It comes straight back here.
I already have a backup file
Tags note what your day was made of. Keep the groups that fit your life.
Tap a group to leave it out. You can add, rename or remove tags any time in More → Tags.
